decisions.reason: The historic mill tour draws on the firm's heritage and its event facilities, so it supports the experience positioning, though pandemic-era disruptions to tours make its results less certain than those of the core baked goods.

The sweet pastry is a low-cost extension of the traditional range with no reported shortfall, and in a growing market there is no performance gap that would trigger a search for other uses of its resources.
The farmhouse bread sits close to the core assortment, but the hearty loaf (Product A) was dropped quickly, so bread variants face some risk of being consolidated if results fall below aspiration.
The gold-awarded poppy seed stollen is presented as a flagship and exceeds aspiration levels, which makes withdrawal very unlikely.
The gold-awarded premium stollen supports the firm's quality and seasonal gift positioning, so its results meet aspiration and there is little reason to drop it.
